text:
Alex Kim: Quick check — auditflow: where are we on KMS <-> HSM orchestration for SOC2 evidence ingestion? Need owners and blockers for next milestone (fieldwork by 2026-04-05).
Marta Alvarez: Owning orchestration config + rollout. Working on gating criteria. ETA for canary is Wed 2026-03-20.
Samir Patel: Doing HSM driver tweaks, still chasing vendor certs. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/infer/auditflow/pulls/327 — pinging reviewer list.
Jules (ci-bot): build #312 passed · integration-tests:auditflow-hsm · 12m
DevOps (team): FYI I dropped an initial helm values in the PR — see snippet:
```
kms:
  provider: 'cloud-kms'
  keyRing: 'rw-keyring-prod'
hsm:
  enabled: true
  slot: 0
rotation:
  schedule: '30d'
  autoRotate: false
```
Marta Alvarez: Need to confirm rotation policy with Security/compliance. @Samir any issues enabling autoRotate? :thinking: 
Samir Patel: AutoRotate blocked by vendor API rate limits and attestation flow. Propose manual rotate + script for now.
Alex Kim: Can someone post where audit logs/evidence will land? auditors need path.
DevOps (team): s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/auditflow/ — logs, manifests, evidence.json
Marta Alvarez: I'll add manifest + runbook to that prefix, and request ACLs for audit-read-only.
Samir Patel: Next blocker: KMS-HSM attestation handshake failing on staging (log snippet below)
```
ERROR: Attestation failed: nonce mismatch
  at attestation/handshake.go:82
```
Marta Alvarez: Ok I'll pair with @Samir tomorrow 09:30 PT to debug. Can someone review the PR for gating? Alex?
Alex Kim: I'm +1 for the gating criteria but want a small test matrix added to PR. Will review by EOD today.
Jules (ci-bot): deploy canary -> staging started · 5m
DevOps (team): tagging compliance-owners: @Marta Alvarez, @Alex Kim, @Samir Patel. Please ack when you have actions.
Marta Alvarez: ack
Samir Patel: ack — pairing tomorrow
Alex Kim: ack — will review PR
DevOps (team): noted, milestone set: fieldwork-ready by 2026-04-05. I'll update the milestone in Asana.
Alex Kim: thanks all :thumbsup:
